67348.rationale: Open field. China (2025 Asia Cup runner-up) and host Japan (could add NBA players Hachimura/Kawamura, since the men's event reportedly runs Sep 10-20, before NBA camps) are gold favourites. The bronze usually goes to a strong semi-final loser. Philippines are in Group C with Jordan, Bahrain and Thailand.
67348.next_info: Final rosters (Aug-Sep 2026); FIBA WC qualifier windows Jul 2-6 and Aug 27-31; full group draw/schedule; tournament Sep 10-20 (SF Sep 18, medal games Sep 20).

224082.rationale: Yu Yiting set a 2:06.82 Asian record (world leader) at the June 2026 Chinese trials, beating Yu Zidi (2:09.33 there, PB 2:07.41). Both qualified as the top two. Japan's Narita is about 2s slower.
224082.next_info: Asian Games swim schedule/entries (Sep); Pan Pacs Aug 12-15 (Narita); any Chinese summer meets.

300850.rationale: Yu Zidi won the Chinese trials in 4:30.79 (world No. 2 this season); Ke Wenxi was 2nd in 4:33.59. Narita (2025 world silver) won the Japan nationals in 4:35.16 and is targeting the Chinese swimmers at home.
300850.next_info: Pan Pacs Aug 12-15 (Narita time); Yu Zidi event programme/clashes at Asian Games (Sep); final race ~Sep 21-23.

832291.rationale: North Korea's Ri Song Gum won 2023 Asian Games 49kg gold (216). She also won the 2025 Worlds 48kg with world records (213), 14kg ahead of Mirabai. The main risk is North Korean non-participation in Japan or a non-selection. China's 49kg entrant is unknown.
832291.next_info: DPRK Asian Games entry list (Aug-Sep); China weightlifting selection; Mirabai at CWG Jul 23-Aug 2 (48kg).

190556.rationale: Qin Haiyang (WR holder, 2025 world champion) withdrew from the 200 breast at the June 2026 Chinese trials and reportedly misses the Games in that event. Dong Zhihao missed the final. China's entries are Mai Shiting (2:09.33) and Wang Junteng. Japan's Ohashi (100br WJR 58.67) and Watanabe are favourites at home.
190556.next_info: Confirm China's 200br entries (possible exemption for Qin); Japan's 200br times at Japan nationals/Pan Pacs (Aug 12-15); Korea entries.

686508.rationale: Puripol Boonson (THA) has a 9.94 PB (Dec 2025), ran a 20.03 200m NR in June 2026, and won 2023 Asian Games silver. Japan is weakened: Tada won the trials in 10.17, Kiryu was 3rd, Sani Brown did not enter and Yanagita/Sakai were injured. Chinese sprint form is unknown.
686508.next_info: Japan's 2nd 100m selection; Chinese championships results; Puripol summer races; Asian Games athletics ~Sep 27-Oct 3.

996188.rationale: Japan's only Puyo Puyo representative is 10-year-old 'Yuki' (ゆうき, @kryu_puyo, born 2015-06-18). He won the GigaCrysta Puyo Puyo Grand Prix Final 2026 and the Japan final selection. Japanese players dominate Puyo Puyo. His full real name is unpublished, so the handle is used.
996188.next_info: JOC formal approval; official Asian Games entry list (may show his legal full name -> update outcome string); esports Sep 23-Oct 2.

259249.rationale: Sindhu is selected for women's singles and is world No. 10 (June 2026). Her 2026 results are mostly QFs plus one SF, and she is 0-9 vs An Se-young. As a likely 5-8 seed she would face a top-4 seed in the QF.
259249.next_info: BWF results Jul-Sep (World Championships Aug 2026), Asian Games seeding/draw (Sep); team event precedes individual.

556932.rationale: Sivasangari (world No. 5) reached the PSA Tour Finals final in June 2026, beating Orfi, and has an 8-1 record vs Watanabe (world No. 6, home player). Next-best Asians: Anahat Singh (~20) and Tomato Ho (2025 Asian champion). The gold also earns an LA28 spot.
556932.next_info: Early 2026-27 PSA results (Aug-Sep); injuries; Asian Games squash draw (Sep 19-Oct 4).

700005.rationale: Defending champion Ng Eain Yow (MAS) was world No. 16-19 in early 2026 and is the top-ranked Asian, but in mixed form. Rivals: Abhay Singh (IND, No. 26), Abdulla Al-Tamimi (QAT, ~20s, 2025 Asian runner-up), Alex Lau (HKG, 2025 Asian champion) and Noor Zaman (PAK, U23 world champion).
700005.next_info: PSA rankings/results Aug-Sep 2026; Asian Games seeding & draw.

695205.rationale: Sri Lanka's Pathirage leads the world in 2026 (92.62m in Rome, wins in Ostrava and Doha). Neeraj returned from a back injury with 85.69m (4th in Doha) and is a strong big-meet performer who won the 2018 and 2023 Asiad. Nadeem (Olympic champion) has not competed in 2026 but says he is targeting the Asian Games.
695205.next_info: CWG Glasgow Jul 23-Aug 2 (all three may meet); DL Lausanne Aug 21, Zurich Aug 27, DL Final Sep 4-5; Ultimate Champs Sep 11-13; Arshad fitness news.

889545.rationale: China fields its 2003-born U23 group plus 3 overage players. It reached the Jan 2026 U23 Asian Cup final but lost 0-4 to Japan. Korea (3-time defending champion) and Japan (U21 group at home) are the likely knockout eliminators. The draw is on Jul 23, 2026.
889545.next_info: Asian Games football draw Jul 23 2026 (re-weight by bracket); China U23 squad/overage picks; tournament ~Sep.

574485.rationale: El Hammamy has been No. 1 since the U.S. Open (late 2025). She won the June 2026 Tour Finals after Orfi lost in the semis, which guaranteed her No. 1 into next season. Orfi (world No. 2, 2026 World and British Open champion) is close behind and could overtake via early 2026-27 events or drop-offs.
574485.next_info: Weekly PSA rankings (Mondays) Jul-Sep 2026; early-season events Aug-Sep; points dropping from Jul-Sep 2025 events.
